text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Inari One began resting 
and recuperating in the dorms—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...So, where are we heading now? The sun's 
already starting to go down.
choice_data_list:
You'll have to wait until we get there to 
find out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's that supposed to mean? Well, 
whatever, but listen--

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have time to be fooling around 
like this... What the heck am I doing...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Inari One still carrying a heavy 
burden in her heart, we head toward a 
certain place.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Boss! What's the meaning of this?! 
This bus is headed straight for my 
hometown!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Boss! What's the meaning of this?! 
This bus is headed straight for my 
hometown!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why now of all times—
choice_data_list:
Right now, I want you to trust me as your 
partner.

Right now, I want you to trust me as your 
partner.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
............Alright, fine. I owe Boss more 
favors than I can count anyway. Least I 
can do is tag along for this.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
............Alright, fine. I owe Big Sis 
more favors than I can count anyway. Least 
I can do is tag along for this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just as the sun was about to set, we 
reached our destination—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What on earth is this—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I-I can see that much just by looking! 
What I'm asking is why there's a festival 
happening here of all times—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Wait. What on earth is written over 
there...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“The Famous Downtown Umamusume”... “Inari 
One”... “Festival for Full Recovery”...?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the heck is going on here, hey?!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
“—What's this? You're looking a lot more 
energetic than what I'd heard.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Inari-neesan! Great work today!! The rest 
of the team is here too, so let's have 
some fun!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chan! From the young'uns to us old 
codgers, we've all gathered here today! 
Let's make a real big racket!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Geez, the ladies were so excited to hear 
Inari-chan was visiting after all this 
time that they really went all out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone... why...?
choice_data_list: Everyone downtown did this for you

Everyone in Shitamachi put this together 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Heh, what's all this "folks from downtown" 
stuff? Don't be a stranger, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"Who was the very first person to consult 
me, bow their head to everyone around 
here, and take the lead in preparing all 
the way up until today?!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss—
choice_data_list:
B-Boss! You promised you wouldn't say 
that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Big Sis—
choice_data_list:
B-Boss! You promised you wouldn't say 
that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...... ......Please, just stop it—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please stop this already!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I swore I'd claim the 'top' for everyone's 
sake! That I'd become 'Horse Girl of the 
Year'! I talked so big back then, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And look at me...! In this pathetic state 
right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The feelings entrusted to me by 
everyone... I... brushed them aside... I 
wasn't even able to carry them on my 
shoulders...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
To someone as... as crude and unrefined as 
me...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I don't deserve anyone's kindness!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's shout echoes. But not a single 
person, myself included, makes a move to 
step away from her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: ......Thanks, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
About how much you've cared for us, 
working so hard till today that you were 
almost crushed under the weight of it 
all...

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad, sure... and I'm proud of it, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever Big Sis was having one hell 
of a brawl in big Central races like the 
Tenno Sho (Spring) or the Takarazuka 
Kinen—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
I was super duper happy! To think an 
Umamusume that cool is representing all of 
us!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
—Man, that was thrilling! The Mainichi 
Okan, and the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! 
Inari-chan ran so magnificently on the big 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
Watching you go toe-to-toe with the 
strongest of our era, it took everything I 
had not to burst into tears, you know?! 
Wahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Seeing little Inari-chan, who used to be 
so tiny, having so many people chant her 
name at the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but burst into tears. I 
might've cried even harder than at my own 
daughter's wedding!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
...Inari. You called yourself "uncouth" 
just a moment ago, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
None of the folks here think like that for 
a second.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
You ran for our sake, and gave us more 
than we could ever carry. You, more than 
anyone else—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: Nothin' but pure "style," obviously.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
You know, just seeing Inari-chan running 
in the Central League is the best feeling 
in the world for us!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! Just seeing you run, 
Inari-chan, makes this old lady feel glad 
to be alive!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you've already... long been our 
very own "Lady Inari"!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"...So hey. Don't be so hard on yourself 
anymore."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: You... just need to fight your own fight.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh, guh......!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuuuugh! Waaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's tears overflowed like a burst 
dam, glittering in the festival lights, 
while the people of Ohi and I simply 
watched in silence...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Boss. Everyone. And... Mister.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Boss. Everyone. And... Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Truly... thanks a lot. Getting to bawl my 
eyes out like that made me feel completely 
refreshed from the core of my being!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Time to switch gears! With a festival 
thrown for me like this, I can't keep 
moping around with a long face! To 
celebrate my recovery, let's party, 
partyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Heh— You've already been full of vinegar 
this whole time, ya damn fool!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Downtown People
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(—I wonder why. Making noise with everyone 
like this made me remember the old days.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(—The festivals I saw as a kid. At the 
most crucial moments, when tension peaked, 
the adults in town would always look sharp 
and hype everyone up.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I asked her on that day. About how she 
managed to look so stylish and cool.)

text_block_list.name: Downtown Adult
text_block_list.text:
—I can't fail, I can't lose, I've gotta do 
this. Moments with that kind of tension 
are what the biggest festival showdowns 
are all about.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Adult
text_block_list.text:
Flip side is, once you figure that out, 
you'll know in a snap where to make your 
move. After that, it's just about having 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Downtown Adult
text_block_list.text:
It feels awesome! Pullin' off the big play 
when it counts, and watchin' everyone's 
hopes explode into the sky like a firework 
called Me!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Adult
text_block_list.text:
That is the spirit of the festival, the 
true essence of 'chic'!

text_block_list.name: Young Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! I don't really get it, but it 
feels super "chic"...!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Adult
text_block_list.text:
You'll understand one day too, Inari-chan. 
When you're standing right in front of a 
grand festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. I didn't get it back then, 
but now I understand what everyone was 
saying.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The spirit of the festival. The very 
essence of 'chic.' And... What I was 
lacking right now!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the festival praying for full recovery 
drew to a close, Inari One and I decided 
to burn the festival sights into our 
memory from the shrine one last time—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—I've finally realized. What it was that I 
was lacking.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking so much about doing it for 
everyone's sake... that all I cared about 
was winning and the results.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The most important part was... I'd 
completely forgotten that I was the one 
who started this fight in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it's about fulfilling everyone's 
hopes. But hey, there was something else 
before that, wasn't there?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My... my very own... spark of "the Local 
circuits ain't losing to the Central"...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You can't have a festival alone. But even 
before that... without me wishing to hold 
one, it wouldn't happen at all!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This brawl is... Inari One's brawl!! I'm 
the one taking the "top" spot!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. At the greatest 
festival of all, I'll definitely nail it 
this time."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Carrying everyone's hopes right here, I'm 
gonna settle my own fight once and for 
all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"And I'm gonna become the fireworks that 
everyone looks up to— standing right at 
the very 'top' of the Twinkle Series!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's why, Boss—
choice_data_list:
Starting tomorrow, let's do our best 
together again

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's why, Big Sis—
choice_data_list:
Starting tomorrow, let's do our best 
together again

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list:
You can't throw a festival all by 
yourself, after all!

You can't throw a festival all by 
yourself, after all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Hahaha, you got that right!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I'm counting on you, partner. Together 
with me— let's make the Arima Kinen the 
greatest festival ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, toward the biggest and final 
festival of the year, I began taking steps 
forward with Inari One once again!
